verses.text: Therefore if there is any encouragement in Christ, if there is any consolation of love, if there is any fellowship of the Spirit, if any affection and compassion,
verses.textZh: 所以，在基督裡若有甚麼勸勉，愛心有甚麼安慰，聖靈有甚麼交通，心中有甚麼慈悲憐憫，

verses.text: make my joy complete by being of the same mind, maintaining the same love, united in spirit, intent on one purpose.
verses.textZh: 你們就要意念相同，愛心相同，有一樣的心思，有一樣的意念，使我的喜樂可以滿足。

verses.text: Do nothing from selfishness or empty conceit, but with humility of mind regard one another as more important than yourselves;
verses.textZh: 凡事不可結黨，不可貪圖虛浮的榮耀；只要存心謙卑，各人看別人比自己強。

verses.text: do not [merely] look out for your own personal interests, but also for the interests of others.
verses.textZh: 各人不要單顧自己的事，也要顧別人的事。

verses.text: Have this attitude in yourselves which was also in Christ Jesus,
verses.textZh: 你們當以基督耶穌的心為心：

verses.text: who, although He existed in the form of God, did not regard equality with God a thing to be grasped,
verses.textZh: 他本有神的形像，不以自己與神同等為強奪的；

verses.text: but emptied Himself, taking the form of a bond-servant, [and] being made in the likeness of men.
verses.textZh: 反倒虛己，取了奴僕的形像，成為人的樣式；

verses.text: Being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself by becoming obedient to the point of death, even death on a cross.
verses.textZh: 既有人的樣子，就自己卑微，存心順服，以至於死，且死在十字架上。

verses.text: For this reason also, God highly exalted Him, and bestowed on Him the name which is above every name,
verses.textZh: 所以，神將他升為至高，又賜給他那超乎萬名之上的名，

verses.text: so that at the name of Jesus EVERY KNEE WILL BOW, of those who are in heaven and on earth and under the earth,
verses.textZh: 叫一切在天上的、地上的，和地底下的，因耶穌的名無不屈膝，

verses.text: and that every tongue will confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
verses.textZh: 無不口稱耶穌基督為主，使榮耀歸與父神。

verses.text: So then, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your salvation with fear and trembling;
verses.textZh: 這樣看來，我親愛的弟兄，你們既是常順服的，不但我在你們那裡，就是我如今不在你們那裡，更是順服的，就當恐懼戰兢做成你們得救的工夫。

verses.text: for it is God who is at work in you, both to will and to work for [His] good pleasure.
verses.textZh: 因為你們立志行事都是神在你們心裡運行，為要成就他的美意。

verses.text: Do all things without grumbling or disputing;
verses.textZh: 凡所行的，都不要發怨言，起爭論，

verses.text: so that you will prove yourselves to be blameless and innocent, children of God above reproach in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you appear as lights in the world,
verses.textZh: 使你們無可指摘，誠實無偽，在這彎曲悖謬的世代作神無瑕疵的兒女。你們顯在這世代中，好像明光照耀，

verses.text: holding fast the word of life, so that in the day of Christ I will have reason to glory because I did not run in vain nor toil in vain.
verses.textZh: 將生命的道表明出來，叫我在基督的日子好誇我沒有空跑，也沒有徒勞。

verses.text: But even if I am being poured out as a drink offering upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice and share my joy with you all.
verses.textZh: 我以你們的信心為供獻的祭物，我若被澆奠在其上，也是喜樂，並且與你們眾人一同喜樂。

verses.text: You too, [I urge you], rejoice in the same way and share your joy with me.
verses.textZh: 你們也要照樣喜樂，並且與我一同喜樂。

verses.text: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you shortly, so that I also may be encouraged when I learn of your condition.
verses.textZh: 我靠主耶穌指望快打發提摩太去見你們，叫我知道你們的事，心裡就得著安慰。

verses.text: For I have no one [else] of kindred spirit who will genuinely be concerned for your welfare.
verses.textZh: 因為我沒有別人與我同心，實在罣念你們的事。

verses.text: For they all seek after their own interests, not those of Christ Jesus.
verses.textZh: 別人都求自己的事，並不求耶穌基督的事。

verses.text: But you know of his proven worth, that he served with me in the furtherance of the gospel like a child [serving] his father.
verses.textZh: 但你們知道提摩太的明證；他興旺福音，與我同勞，待我像兒子待父親一樣。

verses.text: Therefore I hope to send him immediately, as soon as I see how things [go] with me;
verses.textZh: 所以，我一看出我的事要怎樣了結，就盼望立刻打發他去；

verses.text: and I trust in the Lord that I myself also will be coming shortly.
verses.textZh: 但我靠著主自信我也必快去。

verses.text: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother and fellow worker and fellow soldier, who is also your messenger and minister to my need;
verses.textZh: 然而，我想必須打發以巴弗提到你們那裡去。他是我的兄弟，與我一同做工，一同當兵，是你們所差遣的，也是供給我需用的。

verses.text: because he was longing for you all and was distressed because you had heard that he was sick.
verses.textZh: 他很想念你們眾人，並且極其難過，因為你們聽見他病了。

verses.text: For indeed he was sick to the point of death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only but also on me, so that I would not have sorrow upon sorrow.
verses.textZh: 他實在是病了，幾乎要死；然而神憐恤他，不但憐恤他，也憐恤我，免得我憂上加憂。

verses.text: Therefore I have sent him all the more eagerly so that when you see him again you may rejoice and I may be less concerned [about you].
verses.textZh: 所以我越發急速打發他去，叫你們再見他，就可以喜樂，我也可以少些憂愁。

verses.text: Receive him then in the Lord with all joy, and hold men like him in high regard;
verses.textZh: 故此，你們要在主裡歡歡樂樂的接待他，而且要尊重這樣的人；

verses.text: because he came close to death for the work of Christ, risking his life to complete what was deficient in your service to me.
verses.textZh: 因他為做基督的工夫，幾乎至死，不顧性命，要補足你們供給我的不及之處。
